attempts.text:
**The window starts in a persistent run.** Columns 0 to 11, `grxA` to `gstB`, are spine columns carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 26% of calls. The model names 94% of genes there on average, but column 3, `rcdA`, is the window's second most hesitant at 1.08 bits and its fewest named at 69%.

**Column 12 is variable and the most plastic.** `yliI`, an aldose sugar dehydrogenase, is carried by 88% of chromosomes, and 26% of calls there are in a region of plasticity, the highest of any column. It is also the most hesitant column of the window, 1.27 bits, and the model names only 79%.

**A short spine follows, then forks.** Columns 13 and 14, `bssR` and `rimO`, are spine at 92%, named 87% on average. Columns 15 and 16 fork: `dgcI` at 86%, then `pdeI` at 76%, with a branch of phage tail and transposase families at 14 to 22%. Columns 17 to 27 are spine again, `gsiD` to `ybiV`, [[glutathione transport and molybdopterin biosynthesis]], named 96% on average.

**The long fork and variable tail.** Columns 30 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 4 to 29% of calls, named 91% on average. Two branches run through them: four capsid and terminase families at columns 30 to 33, and ten families, [[phage replication and regulation]], at columns 37 to 46. The model names 76% at column 58 and hesitates most at column 79, `ybhC`, 1.00 bits, carried by 22%.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 1.46 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 73% against 96%; 7,046 of 42,800 calls are inside one. Across the window it names 92% of genes at 0.41 bits.

label: grxA
facts:
WINDOW: the grxA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor grxA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,864 to 2,943 from dnaA. Read in 535 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying grxA once); 42,800 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.41 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,573 calls, named 97%, 0.15 bits; shell 8,146 calls, named 80%, 0.98 bits; cloud 1,081 calls, named 19%, 3.95 bits. Outside an RGP 35,754 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 7,046 calls, named 73%, 1.46 bits. Columns: 26 spine, 20 fork, 34 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.46 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (73% against 96%); 7,046 of the 42,800 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 12 (yliI) 1.27 bits, RGP 26%; column 3 (rcdA) 1.08 bits, RGP 26%; column 79 (ybhC) 1.00 bits, RGP 28%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 12 (variable), RGP 26%; the least: columns 30-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 4-29%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-11 (12 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-26%. Genes: grxA, ybjM "inner membrane protein YbjM", ybjL "aspartate:alanine antiporter", rcdA, ybjJ "MFS transporter", ybjI "HAD hydrolase family protein", ybjH, mdfA, ybjG "undecaprenyl-diphosphate phosphatase", deoR, dacC, gstB. named 69-99.8% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3 (rcdA), named 69%, 1.08 bits.
2. column 12 variable: RGP 26%. named 79%; 1.27 bits.
   12: yliI P 88% "aldose sugar dehydrogenase YliI"
3. columns 13-14 (2 columns) spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 26%. Genes: bssR, rimO. named 84-89% (mean 87%), fewest named at column 14 (rimO), named 84%; most hesitant at column 13 (bssR), 0.59 bits.
4. columns 15-16 (2 columns) fork: RGP 26%. named 78-87% (mean 83%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 15, named 78%, 0.88 bits.
   15: dgcI P 86%; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system RelE/Par…" S 22%, "phage tail protein" S 14%
   16: pdeI S 76%; also "helix-turn-helix domain-containing prot…" S 23%, "phage tail protein I" S 20%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 18%
5. columns 17-27 (11 columns) spine: share 91-92%, all P, RGP 22-26%. Genes: gsiD "glutathione ABC transporter permeas…", gsiC, gsiB, gsiA, iaaA, moeA "molybdopterin molybdotransferase Mo…", moeB, fsa, ybiY "glycyl-radical enzyme activating pr…", ybiW "formate C-acetyltransferase/glycero…", ybiV "HAD hydrolase family protein". named 92-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 17 (gsiD), named 92%; most hesitant at column 20 (gsiA), 0.55 bits.
6. column 28 fork: RGP 24%. named 96%; 0.24 bits.
   28: ybiU S 78% "YbiU family protein"; also "head completion/stabilization protein" S 20%
7. column 29 spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 25%. Genes: ybiT "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…". named 90%; 0.38 bits.
8. columns 30-79 (50 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 4-29%. named 76-96% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 58, named 76%; most hesitant at column 79, 1.00 bits.
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 30-33, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 20-22%, all S; the branch's families: "P2 family phage major capsid protein", "GPO family capsid scaffolding protein", "phage terminase large subunit family pr…", "phage portal protein"
   a second branch of 10 families through columns 37-46, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 15-26%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "replication endonuclease", "DNA adenine methylase", "TraR/DksA family transcriptional regula…", "DUF2732 family protein", "DUF5347 family protein", "phage filamentation protein Fil family…", "phage regulatory CII family protein", "regulator", "phage repressor protein CI"
